about.title: About Waffle Orbit
about.subtitle: Orbit of Taste... Beyond the Usual!
about.storyP1: Waffle Orbit was born in Sankarankovil with a bold mission: to introduce an international dessert bar experience while creating our own proprietary culinary breakthroughs like the sealed UFO flying-saucer burger and stone-baked rectangular pizzas.
about.storyP2: We believe good food creates good moods and unforgettable memories. Every Belgian waffle is prepared with fresh batter on cast-iron plates, and our crispy broast chicken is 100% Halal certified and marinated for twelve hours.
